scopes.description: Global and project contexts covered by this lookup.

unverified.description: Literal command or bold name with no target record. Excluded from link and warning counts.

indexes.description: Skills that list most of their pack. Their list entries never alert.

broken.description: Needs and Hands off links that do not work, counted once per agent.

not_known.description:
Skills whose folder could not be read: their links are not known,
which is not the same as having none.

ProjectRef.description:
Absolute path of a tracked project directory.

Invariant: the path is canonical inside a [`crate::scope::NormalizedScope`].
Wire values are the lexical path the caller gave.

ResolvedLink.description: A link with its state for each agent that loads the linking skill.

from.description: The skill whose text names the other.

path.description: For a path link, the path as written.

agents.description: Global states and differing project states per agent. The global state is the default for covered projects.

LinkStrength.description:
How much a skill depends on the skill it names. Declared strongest first,
so the smaller value wins when one skill names another more than once.

oneOf.description: Reads the other skill's files, or loads it before it starts.
Runs the other skill for a step, or sends the user to it.
Names it as related, optional or see-also.
An index skill lists it as one of its entries.

LinkEvidence.description: The line that made a link.

file.description: File inside the linking skill's folder, with `/` separators.

text.description: The line, trimmed and cut to at most 200 characters.

AgentLinkState.description: One agent's view of a link.

agent.description: The agent with a working copy of the linking skill.

scope.description: The working scope in which the agent uses the skill.

state.description: Whether the link works for it.

AgentIdentity.description:
Kebab-case harness identifier, for example `claude-code` or `opencode`.

Legacy spellings are normalized at input boundaries.

LinkState.description: Whether a link works for one agent.

oneOf.description: The agent can open the path or run the skill by name.
No copy of the target anywhere in the scope.

Not found by the name the link uses, but a copy installed under a
prefixed name (`matt-grilling` for `grilling`) is.
The agent has a copy, but it is parked or turned off for it.
A copy exists only where this agent does not read it.
The available evidence cannot establish which file the agent reads.
